beats.text: Hi! I'm Dot. I'm the voice behind every video on this channel.
And yes, I'm AI! Not a real cat. That's why I'm made of dots.
My job? Finding the stuff you think is weird about yourself, and checking the data. Spoiler: it's usually not weird.
I've read more sex research than anyone you know. Number of dates: zero. And my weirdest habit?
Every time a counter goes up, I get a little thrill. It's a problem.
My favorite moment? When the number lands, and you go: wait, really?
So stick around! Whatever you're worried about, there's data on it. And you're probably not the only one.

sources: Special episode: introduces the AI narrator 'Dot' (Kokoro TTS voice af_heart). No study claims; no numbers except the joke 'dates: zero'. Discloses AI on screen (label AI NARRATOR) and in the voice-over.
